evidence: The CLI command is registered and named `cas-gc-rebuild`, not `ca-gc-rebuild`: programs/disks/DisksApp.cpp:347 (`command_descriptions.emplace("cas-gc-rebuild", makeCommandCaGcRebuild());`) and programs/disks/CommandCaGcRebuild.cpp:34 (`command_name = "cas-gc-rebuild";`). The claimed spelling `clickhouse-disks ca-gc-rebuild --disk <name> [--force]` does not exist at HEAD.

No `WatermarkKeeper` or `HeartbeatKeeper` classes exist. The actual single-writer/heartbeat machinery is `MountLeaseKeeper` (extends `SingleWriterSlot`) declared in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasServerRoot.h:611, with the remount/watermark logic in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasMountRuntime.cpp (`CasMountRuntime::scheduleRemount`, CasMountRuntime.cpp:432).

The ProfileEvents are registered with uppercase `CAS`, not the claimed mixed-case spelling: src/Common/ProfileEvents.cpp:797-798 define `CASRefMaterializeInPlace` and `CASRefMaterializeCopy`, incremented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefCowMap.cpp:210,231.

The counters are `CASRefBatchFlushes`/`CASRefBatchedMutations` (uppercase CAS), not the claimed mixed-case spelling: incremented at src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefLedger.cpp:3824-3825, registered as ProfileEvents in src/Common/ProfileEvents.cpp.

The counters referenced by the claim are actually `CASRefBatchFlushes`/`CASRefBatchedMutations` (uppercase CAS), not the mixed-case spelling asserted: src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefLedger.cpp:3824-3825 and src/Disks/tests/gtest_cas_ref_chunked_flush.cpp:589 both use the uppercase form.

The dedup counters are `CASBlobHeadFirst`/`CASBlobBodyPutAvoided` (uppercase CAS), not the claimed mixed-case spelling: registered in src/Common/ProfileEvents.cpp:767-768 and incremented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPartWriteTxn.cpp:203,207.

Only the runtime metric keys `acquired` and `steal_allowed` were found (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Gc/CasGc.cpp:505-506, t.metric("acquired", ...) / t.metric("steal_allowed", ...)). Searched utils/ca-soak logs and RUN_HISTORY.md for a T14 run matching '41 minutes 32 seconds', 'acquired=0', or 'steal_allowed=248' (including utils/ca-soak/failure_t14.json and the ch1/ch2_pre_t14* log directories) and found no record of this specific measurement. The specific numeric soak-run result cannot be confirmed or refuted from any artifact present in the repository.

The event is registered and used as `ProfileEvents::CASRefSnapshotPublishDispatched` (uppercase CAS), not `CasRefSnapshotPublishDispatched`: src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefLedger.cpp:66,3994.

CAS recovery backoff uses a condition-variable `wait_for` tied to a shutdown/stop signal: src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasMountRuntime.cpp:466 (`remount_cv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::milliseconds(backoff_ms), ...)` inside `CasMountRuntime::scheduleRemount`, CasMountRuntime.cpp:432), which lets pool teardown interrupt the retry backoff rather than waiting it out.

No `WatermarkKeeper`, `HeartbeatKeeper`, or `SingleWriterSlotKeeper` exist. The unification the claim proposes has already happened: `MountLeaseKeeper : public SingleWriterSlot` is defined at src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasServerRoot.h:60,611, with the shared background loop `SingleWriterSlot::backgroundLoop` at CasServerRoot.cpp:1410.

No `store_blob_safely` function exists. The write path that handles logical-hash-key reuse is `PartWriteTxn::putBlob`, declared/documented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPartWriteTxn.cpp (e.g. comments at lines 29-108 describing the durable write order `stageManifest -> precommitAdd -> putBlob -> promote`); no function or expression matching the claim's exact name/verification call exists at HEAD.

No `MultiDelete` symbol exists anywhere under src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/. CAS deletion is single-key: `deleteExact` is used at src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Gc/CasOrphanManifestSweep.cpp:586 (`backend.deleteExact(listed.key, head.token)`), consistent with a sequential, no-batch-delete baseline.

The counter is `CASPartFolderManifestGets` (uppercase CAS), incremented in `CasManifestReader::readManifestShared` (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasManifestReader.cpp:91, method declared at CasManifestReader.h:51), not on any `Store` class - callers hold a `Cas::PoolPtr store` (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Parts/PartFolderAccess.h:365) and invoke `store->readManifestShared(...)`, but the type providing the method is `CasManifestReader`, not `Store`.
The profile event is `CASPartFolderManifestGets` (uppercase CAS), registered at src/Common/ProfileEvents.cpp:894, not the claimed lowercase-prefix `CasPartFolderManifestGets`.

All six counters use uppercase `CAS` and the CAS variant is named `CASMetaCompareSwap`, not `CasMetaCas`: `CASMetaPut`/`CASMetaCompareSwap`/`CASMetaDelete` registered and incremented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasBlobMeta.cpp:8-10,27,34,41; `CASMetaCreateClean`/`CASMetaAdoptBackfill`/`CASMetaResurrectClean` in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPartWriteTxn.cpp:26-28.

The dedup-cache counters are named `CASDeduplicationCacheHits`/`CASDeduplicationCacheMisses`, not `CasDedupCacheHits`/`CasDedupCacheMisses` - a different word choice, not just a casing change. Registered and incremented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPool.cpp:63-64,259,262.

There is no `SYSTEM CONTENT ADDRESSED FORGET` verb. The implemented decommission query is `SYSTEM CAS FORGET`, handled in src/Interpreters/InterpreterSystemQuery.cpp:2625 (`throw ... "SYSTEM CAS FORGET requires an explicit disk name"`) and 2634.

No `RefApplyState` type exists at HEAD. The current persistent lane state type is `RefLaneState`, used in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPool.h, CasPool.cpp, and CasRefLedger.h/.cpp, confirming the old encoding described by the claim was removed and replaced.

The counters are `CASBlobUploadFanoutBatches`/`CASBlobUploadFanoutTasks` (uppercase CAS), registered at src/Common/ProfileEvents.cpp:769-770 and incremented in src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/ContentAddressedTransaction.cpp:1718,1775.

The fsck fields `dangling`/`unreachable` do exist and are printed adjacently by `formatFsckSummary` (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Tools/CasFsck.cpp:1155-1157, ` dangling=` << report.dangling << ` unreachable=` << report.unreachable), so that part of the claim is accurate; however the dry-run tool is named `cas-gc-dryrun`, not `ca-gc-dryrun` as claimed: programs/disks/CommandCaGcDryRun.cpp:22 (`command_name = "cas-gc-dryrun";`) and programs/disks/DisksApp.cpp:346.

There is no `SYSTEM CONTENT ADDRESSED UNMOUNT <disk>` verb at HEAD. The implemented CAS system-query verbs are `SYSTEM CAS FORGET` and `SYSTEM CAS GC STOP`/`SYSTEM CAS GC START`, handled in src/Interpreters/InterpreterSystemQuery.cpp:2625,2649,2672 - no UNMOUNT verb or refusal-while-referenced check exists.

No `RefBaseSet` type exists at HEAD. Writable-mount ref startup/recovery is built on `CasRefCatalog` (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefCatalog.h) and `CasRefLedger` (src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasRefLedger.h), not on the claimed `RefBaseSet` metadata type.
